sections.title: New
items: Test three-flag city sieges at Myzea, Marunath, and Balgard in Battle Lab.

sections.title: New
items: NPC castle defenders can attack an enemy Forward Spawn cart they can see and reach inside the castle.

sections.title: Adjusted
items: Ballistas in converted sieges now start with 20 bolts.

sections.title: Adjusted
items: Bazeck, Bhulaban, Mazen, Shapheste, Shulus, and Hanun now have snowy battlefields when attacked in the campaign.

sections.title: New
items: The snowy Castle Battle Lab starts on Slezhk’s Takor map. Admins can switch to Yruma’s Mazhadan map from the Esc menu.

sections.title: Adjusted
items: Expect snow on the ground when attacking Slezhk or Yruma. Takor keeps its summer terrain at Albruq and Bulugha, and Mazhadan keeps its usual terrain at Jeirbe.

sections.title: Adjusted
items: Each of the 43 campaign castles has an assigned siege map based on its home region and architecture. Capturing a castle keeps the same battlefield for its next siege.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Fixed the missing wall pieces used for debris that caused Lochana to crash on load. Restored the same pieces on the edited Jogurys walls.

sections.title: Adjusted
items: Updated defender archer positions in Barihal and Jamayeh, and the left-wall waiting points in Jamayeh and Simira. Updated two wall sections in Jogurys.

sections.title: New
items: On 21 siege maps, hold the middle flag B uncontested for 30 seconds to bring reinforcements forward. Defenders can take it back. You can still choose your home spawn or an available Forward Spawn cart.

sections.title: Adjusted
items: The attacker camp is A and the defender stronghold is C. Both take 120 seconds to capture. Updated 22 siege maps with the editor placements for defender banners.
